After just a few treatments, Jack began feeling better and significant improvements were seen as the swelling began to go down. reviews.text: Iris was a rescue who spent her whole life in a cage. Her right hip was very weak with a funny gait. After her first adjustment, I was very excited about how her gait changed and how much further she could walk and get around without as much pain. I feel like every animal should get chiropractic care because it works so well.
